items.t: Timing belt failure can wreck the engine
items.job: Replace timing belt, tensioner and water pump (preventive)
items.note: If the belt already broke and bent valves, a used engine (often about $1,200 for the engine alone) or head repair costs far more.

items.t: Automatic transmission failure or harsh shifting
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with used or remanufactured unit
items.note: Owners report about $2,000-2,100 for a replacement. Try fluid service and a software update first if it only shifts badly.

items.t: Automatic transmission slipping or failing (first generation)
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with used or rebuilt unit

items.t: Airbag light on from passenger seat occupant sensor
items.job: Replace passenger seat occupant sensor mat (seat cushion assembly)
items.note: Owners report dealer quotes of about $1,600-2,000. Used cushions or specialist sensor repair cost less.

items.t: Fuel tank straps can rust and let the tank drop (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel tank straps and hardware
items.note: Free under the Kia recall for affected cars.

items.t: Passenger airbag may treat a child seat as an adult (recall)
items.job: Reprogram occupant classification computer

items.t: Steering tie rods can crack (recall)
items.job: Replace steering rack with tie rods

items.t: Overheating from a leaking radiator or failed cooling fan
items.job: Replace radiator and thermostat
items.note: If the engine overheated badly, a head gasket job (about $1,200-1,600) may follow.

items.t: Doors lock and unlock on their own
items.job: Replace door latch and lock actuator

items.t: Stalling or loss of power while driving
items.job: Diagnose stalling and clean or replace throttle body/idle valve
items.note: A new throttle body runs about $480-520 installed; a mass airflow sensor about $560-600.

items.t: Fuel smell, gas leaks or trouble filling the tank
items.job: Replace vapor canister vent hose/filter or leaking fuel line

items.t: Blower quits or its wiring overheats
items.job: Replace blower motor, resistor and melted connector
items.note: Owners report up to about $900 when several parts were replaced.

items.t: Check engine light from oxygen sensor wiring
items.job: Repair connector or replace front oxygen sensor

items.t: Hard shift from second to third once warmed up
items.job: Transmission relearn or software update

items.t: Airbag warning light stays on (first generation)
items.job: Replace clock spring or airbag control module

items.t: Starter cable can chafe and cause an engine fire
items.job: Inspect and replace starter cable
items.note: Kia ran a free service campaign for cars built before January 2000.

items.t: Front seat belt buckle may falsely latch (recall)
items.job: Replace front seat belt buckles

items.t: Exhaust pre-silencer pipe cracks and gets loud
items.job: Replace front exhaust pipe/pre-silencer

items.t: Heater stops putting out heat
items.job: Replace heater core

items.t: Worn front wheel bearings humming
items.job: Replace front wheel bearing

items.t: Clunks from worn struts and suspension bushings
items.job: Replace front struts (pair) and worn bushings
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $816-919 for a strut pair.

items.t: Tail and brake light bulbs burn out often
items.job: Replace rear lamp bulbs

items.t: Valve cover gasket oil leak
items.job: Replace valve cover gasket and plug tube seals

items.t: Inside door handle breaks
items.job: Replace inner door handle

items.t: Hard starting and rough idle when cold
items.job: Replace spark plugs and wires; clean idle control valve
